summary: All platforms under 100 followers; Instagram reels lose 77% viewers in first 3 seconds (hook failure). Bio violates rules: niche/region lock, '24 hrs' timeframe, free site check offer beyond website posts. LinkedIn shows zero real engagement.
guidance:
- Hook style: rotate to **mistake** angle (1.46x) paired with **question** hook (1.75x); avoid pure comparison hooks for chatbot posts.
- Avoid repeating 'same five questions' phrasing (used 2026-10-12 & 2026-11-02); vary the pain point.
- Posts must read as a developer sharing real work, never an ad; no demo offers, no niche targeting.

instructions.research: Find 2-3 common chatbot misconceptions small Indian businesses hold (e.g., 'needs coding', 'only for big brands', 'replaces human touch') to fuel a mistake-busting angle.
instructions.analysis: Compare today's chatbot topic against the last two chatbot posts (2026-11-02, 2026-11-08, 2026-11-12) to ensure a fresh pain point and hook style.
instructions.writer: Write a single-image post using a **mistake** angle + **question** hook: highlight one misconception about chatbots, ask a relatable question, end with 'pay after approval' + DM for honest fit check. No niche examples; mention 2-3 varied business types max.
instructions.image: Create a bright-desk style image (1.53x) showing a simple chat card mock-up labelled 'Example conversation' — no business name, no demo claim. Clean, developer-at-work aesthetic.
instructions.video: Skip video today; reel hook retention is too weak (77% 3-sec drop). Focus on static image post to test hook/angle without retention risk.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio: remove niche/region list, 'ready in 24 hrs', and free site check line. Replace with broad, rule-compliant description (e.g., 'AI chatbots, animated ads, lead sheets & websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM to discuss fit.')
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian small business owners (cafes, gyms, clinics, coaches) discussing customer communication struggles — no pitching, just genuine insight.
Reply to any existing comments on your last 3 Instagram posts to boost signal; keep replies helpful, not promotional.
